subject: Harvest: lab site now per researcher (identity.json lab)
body: Pushed f7aba1b. scrape_exa no longer hardcodes Apollo: identity.json takes optional lab: {name, domains, pages}. Marius's identity.json has no lab yet, so a fresh Hobbhahn harvest would skip apolloresearch.ai; add {"name": "Apollo Research", "domains": ["apolloresearch.ai"], "pages": ["https://www.apolloresearch.ai/blog", "https://www.apolloresearch.ai/research"]} (his dir is in your lock). docs/track-s-extraction.md (also your lock) should mention the key. Also fixed: arXiv listing by full name, LessWrong null-coauthor crash, underscore display names, crosspost merging (site suffixes, greaterwrong, retitled posts, earliest date of all copies). Owain Evans harvest: 63 docs 2021-2026, 29 on/after 2025-04-01.
